excluded_as_owned_by_alerts: GRB, FRB and Einstein Probe follow-up

chemistry_and_materials: Nature Chemistry and Nature energy-storage listings
geology_and_palaeontology: Hebei gneiss primary article and expert commentary

selection_notes: No fixed quota. Selected items required same-window publication, primary or authoritative evidence, scientific consequence and enough accessible methods/results to support quantitative statements. Routine publicity, republished older milestones, astrophysical alerts and likely arXiv-highlight duplicates were excluded.
access_gaps: Some Nature HTML requests redirected to an inaccessible identity service; indexed article text or open PDFs were used for selected items.
Searches did not identify a qualifying primary mathematics result newly published in the window.
The astronomy/instrument sweep may not capture announcements absent from indexed official feeds by the cutoff.
